summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by PN Smart Energy Ltd (a Cayman Islands company, formerly Skycorp Solar Group Ltd) reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting and the adoption of a sixth amended and restated memorandum and articles of association effective June 10, 2026. The filing includes the amended memorandum but does not disclose any terms of a specific transaction, such as price per share, premium, or other deal metrics. There is no board recommendation, advisor mention, or structural details beyond routine corporate governance changes. The event appears to be an ordinary charter amendment related to share capital structure. No special-situation event is identified.
